customPrompts.name: Taiwan conventions
customPrompts.value: Write Traditional Chinese as used by developers in Taiwan, with Taiwanese technical terms (程式碼, 檔案, 預設, 設定, 伺服器, 函式, 變數, 物件, 介面) rather than Mainland ones (代码, 文件 for a file, 默认, 配置 for settings, 服务器, 函数, 对象, 接口). Use full-width punctuation in prose, and put a space between Chinese and Latin words or numbers.

customPrompts.name: Japanese conventions
customPrompts.value: Write in the です/ます style of Japanese technical documentation, with Japanese punctuation (、。) and half-width letters, numbers and symbols. Write established technical terms in katakana, like レンダリング and コンポーネント, and keep names of APIs and products in English.

customPrompts.name: Code
customPrompts.value: Keep code identifiers, file paths, package names, commands, options, props and component names exactly as written, also in prose. In code blocks, translate only comments, and keep annotations like `[!code highlight]` and `// @noErrors` unchanged.
